title: Chinese AI Models Gain Ground on Price and Use
summary: Chinese AI models are rapidly closing the performance gap with US rivals while winning users through lower prices and open-weight technology that lets companies deploy them locally. Bloomberg tech reporter Luz Ding told Bloomberg This Weekend that Chinese AI capabilities are approaching leading US models at a fraction of the cost.

title: The AI Spending Spree Comes With a Catch
summary: Former IBM CEO Sam Palmisano warns that the AI boom rests on long-cycle bets in data centers, chips and energy even as AI software evolves at breakneck speed. If adoption slows or cheaper Chinese open-source models gain traction, Big Tech may need to rethink the massive spending plans behind today's AI race.

title: Investing in AI for More Jobs, Less Pay
summary: A Bloomberg newsletter roundup examines the mixed labor-market effects of AI investment, framed as both the good news and bad news about AI for workers.

title: Apollo's Slok Says AI Weighs On Pay Without Cutting Jobs — Yet
summary: Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Slok found something surprising when examining how AI adoption is playing out in the US labor market: it is weighing on wages without yet triggering mass layoffs.

title: Canada vows to match US tariffs as trade talks collapse
summary: Canadian PM Mark Carney rejected what he called an "unfair" trade deal after talks with Washington broke down, with a top US envoy criticizing the outcome as a "missed opportunity." The collapse threatens new US tariffs and adds uncertainty to North American trade just as Mexico pursues its own USMCA renegotiation.

title: Trump afirma que su gobierno comenzó a trabajar en nuevo acuerdo comercial con México
summary: Donald Trump afirmó que su gobierno ya inició negociaciones para un nuevo acuerdo comercial con México, buscando mejores condiciones para Estados Unidos. La tercera ronda bilateral concluyó en julio con avances en reglas de origen, acero, aluminio y sector automotriz, y la siguiente ronda está prevista para la primera semana de septiembre.

title: Trump's challenge: $40tn debt, 6.7% mortgages and $5 diesel
summary: The FT outlines how Trump's economic agenda is under strain as the Iran war pushes up prices and America's fiscal position deteriorates, with US mortgage rates near 6.7% and national debt topping $40 trillion.

title: Bossing the bond market around never works
summary: Despite Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's efforts to influence long-term yields, investors remain uneasy, the FT notes, as history shows governments rarely succeed at commanding bond markets to behave.

title: El nuevo miedo a ser principiante
summary: La irrupción de la IA en el trabajo diario está generando ansiedad incluso entre directivos con años de experiencia, que sienten que deben volver a aprender procesos básicos. El autor argumenta que parte del valor profesional que antes distinguía a los expertos hoy puede resolverse con herramientas de IA accesibles para cualquiera.

title: México y la 'trampa' del bajo crecimiento
summary: La Cepal revisó a la baja su proyección de crecimiento para México en 2026, a 1.3% desde el 1.5% estimado en abril, dentro de un panorama regional en el que Latinoamérica completaría cinco años consecutivos de expansión insuficiente para cerrar brechas de desarrollo. El columnista advierte que México está atrapado en una trayectoria de bajo crecimiento de más de una década.

title: Las claves económicas de la semana (17 al 21 de agosto): De actividad económica y minutas de Banxico y la Fed
summary: Las minutas de Banxico y de la Fed dieron señales sobre la trayectoria de las tasas de interés para lo que resta del año, en una semana también marcada por datos de actividad económica en México. El Indicador Oportuno de la Actividad Económica sugiere que México arrancaría el tercer trimestre con un crecimiento mensual de apenas 0.1% en junio.

title: 5G eleva las exigencias de ciberseguridad para infraestructura crítica
summary: El avance de las redes 5G y la digitalización económica están elevando las exigencias de ciberseguridad para operadores de telecomunicaciones y para sectores que dependen de infraestructura crítica, incluidos los servicios financieros. Especialistas de Ericsson señalan que la mayor integración entre redes y operaciones industriales amplía los puntos vulnerables a ataques, espionaje o robo de información.

title: Mexico Optimistic it Can Achieve Lower US Tariffs on Cars, Steel
summary: Mexico's top trade negotiator expressed optimism that Mexico can secure less burdensome US tariff terms on automobile and steel exports, similar to the revised measures Washington is discussing with Canada.

title: El peso cierra en 16.92 por dólar, pero la economía no levanta
summary: El peso mexicano cerró la sesión en 16.92 unidades por dólar, aunque persisten señales de que la economía del país no logra despegar, según reporte de Expansión.

title: Wall Street Week | AI Hits Wages, USMCA Under Pressure, Colorado River Crisis
summary: This week's Wall Street Week covers why former IBM CEO Sam Palmisano says companies may need a "Plan B" for AI, plus early data suggesting AI is already slowing wage growth in exposed occupations even without mass layoffs. It also examines how Canada's clash with Trump over tariffs could leave lasting damage to USMCA and North American manufacturing.

title: Nvidia to Pay AI Startup Poolside a $6 Billion License, Newcomer Says
summary: Nvidia has agreed to pay $6 billion to license AI models from startup Poolside and will extend job offers to more than 100 of its employees, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Yuval Noah Harari on the economic and political perils of AI
summary: Historian Yuval Noah Harari warns that humanity must not entrust its future to "clever machines," cautioning about the economic and political risks of ceding too much control to AI systems.

title: Anthropic Taps Google Chip Veteran as Part of Push Into Hardware
summary: Anthropic has hired Amir Salek, a founder of Google's custom chip program, as the AI lab lays the groundwork for a push into designing its own semiconductors.

title: Khosla Ventures Bets on AI's Next Frontier: Science
summary: Khosla Ventures is backing Discovery Loop, a new AI startup founded by former Google leaders including Jeff Dean that aims to dramatically accelerate scientific experimentation. Managing Director Samir Kaul says the opportunity could be as significant as frontier AI models, even as soaring valuations force venture investors to rethink what "seed stage" means.

title: Wall Street Struggles to Absorb AI's Debt Boom
summary: Broadcom is reportedly in talks to raise more than $60 billion in debt to help Anthropic and other AI firms secure chips and computing power, highlighting growing concern over how the AI buildout is being financed. Investor Erica Klauer discusses circular-financing risks and the funding challenges facing the sector.

title: Anthropic Aims to Match or Top SpaceX IPO
summary: Anthropic is reportedly targeting an IPO that could rival or exceed SpaceX's record-setting debut, with a public filing possible by the end of the month. The company raised $65 billion in May at a $965 billion valuation, according to Bloomberg's deals and Anthropic coverage teams.

title: Robinhood's Guild on AI, Markets & Risks
summary: Robinhood's Stephanie Guild discusses the market impact of major AI IPOs and concentration risks, along with opportunities in healthcare and compute infrastructure, arguing investors should balance AI exposure with cash-flow-focused, defensive assets.

title: Apple Cuts Jobs in Siri, Vision Pro Immersive Video and Gaming Teams
summary: Apple is cutting jobs across teams responsible for the Siri digital assistant and the Vision Pro headset, part of an effort to refocus resources on new devices and artificial intelligence.

title: Tracking the cost of Donald Trump's tariffs
summary: The Economist's tariff tracker shows America's global effective tariff rate currently stands at 10.0%, offering an ongoing gauge of the cost of Trump's trade policy.

title: Casa Pura Vida / Zozaya Arquitectos
summary: Zozaya Arquitectos designed Casa Pura Vida, a contemporary residence in Troncones, Mexico, that draws on the country's rich construction materials and artisanal craftsmanship to create a unique home for its owners.

title: Semiconductores y CPTPP: la oportunidad que México —y Norteamérica— no debe desaprovechar
summary: Un artículo de opinión en Expansión plantea que México y Norteamérica tienen una oportunidad estratégica en semiconductores a través del CPTPP, que el país no debería desaprovechar.

title: "Art Is Not Fiction, but a Surplus Reality:" Pedro Reyes on Sculpture as Social Practice in Louisiana Channel Interview
summary: Mexican sculptor Pedro Reyes, trained as an architect, discusses in a Louisiana Channel interview how his multidisciplinary practice blends stone carving with participatory "social sculpture" projects addressing contemporary social issues, and why he values preserving craft traditions in an increasingly automated world.
